# M12 Siege of Iron (tag, snow; province: the Iron Bastion, Blue Moon's fortress on the Frost March): the Aurean legion crosses the snowfield and takes Olaf's HQ 2 (17,13) in the heart of three rings of mountain walls (outer about x4..30,y3..23; middle x9..25,y7..19; inner x12..22,y10..16); Andy's HQ 3 (37,13) sits on the east spur. Gaps: outer SW (10,23) SE (24,23) and E (30,13); middle S (17,19) W (9,13) E (25,10); inner SW (13,16) SE (21,16) and N (17,10). The gaps never line up: every ring forces a zigzag along a 3-4 cell corridor under the guns. Threat/answer: Andy's Artillery and Rockets (hold) in the corridors -> Aurelia's extra range, Recons to find them, Bombers from the airport (20,27) (the Missiles (17,5) and AA are far from the south corridor: strike the guns there first), Mechs and Infantry over the mountains straight to the guns; Olaf's Tanks and Md Tanks pour out of the gaps -> Tanks/Md Tanks and Artillery hold the gaps, Rockets/Artillery fire at the choke; Olaf's AA vs the Bomber -> use Artillery on it or Bombers where it cannot reach. Line-up: player Green Earth (Klaus + Aurelia), Olaf Blue Moon, Andy Orange Star. PIPE WALL x13 y20..24 (pipes (13,20) (13,21) (13,23) (13,24), seam (13,22)) closes the south corridor between the outer SW gap and the middle S gap for vehicles: foot can cross the mountains (12..16,20) beside it; break the seam with an attack to open the lane; otherwise the SE gap (24,22) route and the west corridor stay open. Neutral missile silo (28,14) on the outer E approach by road x27. Player start: ART3 ROCK2 RECON3 INF4 MECH3 TANK3 MDT2 AA1 BMB1 (22 units), HQ (17,27), base (13,27), airport (20,27), funds 5000. Olaf: INF4 + MECH2 hold the inner ring, MDT3 TANK3 AA1 advance, ART1 holds; Andy: ART4 ROCK2 MIS1 hold, INF2 MECH1 hold at the spur (24 units, about 1.3x).

# guns: (7, 20) Andy's guns (hold): ART (7,20) SW, (27,20) SE, (6,9) NW, (26,8) NE corridors; ROCK in the south corridor near (13,21) and (22,21); MIS (17,6) north
